create_insecure_channel: create an insecure gRPC channel to a remote host using host and port parameters
create_secure_channel: create a secure gRPC channel to a remote host with channel credentials
create_generic_stub: create a generic gRPC stub on a channel to make RPC calls with optional serialization options
create_dynamic_stub: create a dynamic gRPC stub for a named service with cardinality mappings and optional options
create_grpc_server: create a gRPC server with service implementations and optional thread pool and timeout settings
